# Scope and Parallel-Work Safety Checklist: Design directions for the portfolio

**Purpose**: Validate that scope boundaries, file disjointness from the blog directions feature and the docs-only merge rule are clearly specified.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. It tests the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Out-of-Scope Boundaries

- [x] CHK001 Are all out-of-scope items (real portfolio, content collections, hosting demos, contact form, choosing a direction) listed in one place with none contradicted by a requirement? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Is the boundary between "sample content module" and "content collections" stated so prototype data is not mistaken for the real content model? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Is it clear the invitation only carries a project reference and does not require contact form behaviour or a resolving link? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK004 Is the treatment of the other four projects as index-only entries stated as final, with follow-up for their stories noted? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK005 Is correcting draft story content explicitly excluded from merge conditions and recorded as follow-up work? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is the demo hosting boundary clear: live demos on drc.dev are neither changed nor re-hosted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK007 Is any new dependency, service or external resource ruled out, given adding one changes the major-change analysis? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]

## Disjointness from the Blog Feature

- [x] CHK008 Does the spec name the files or directories the feature owns, or delegate that entirely to the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-045]
- [x] CHK009 Is "must not overwrite each other's work" translated into a checkable rule (no shared path except named exceptions)? [Measurability, Spec §Context, §FR-045]
- [x] CHK010 Are the shared files both features may edit (site config, test template list) identified with a stated conflict-resolution rule? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK011 Is the prototype URL namespace defined so it cannot collide with the blog feature's namespace? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK012 Are the decision document and screenshot locations required to be separate from the blog feature's documents and images? [Completeness, Spec §FR-045]
- [x] CHK013 Is the merge order between the two features addressed, including which reverts of shared edits must survive the other's merge? [Gap]
- [x] CHK014 Is the requirement not to alter "any other feature" specific about tests, baselines and lockfiles as well as content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-045]
- [x] CHK015 Are visual regression baselines addressed so temporary prototypes do not add or change committed baselines? [Gap]

## Merge Contents

- [x] CHK016 Is the list of what may reach main (document, 24 screenshots) exhaustive, with everything else required to be absent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-043, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK017 Is it specified whether the spec folder and checklists merge, given "only the decision document and its screenshots" wording? [Ambiguity, Spec §Context]
- [x] CHK018 Is the order of operations clear: gate, review on preview, removal, merge, without losing the pinned commit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-043, §FR-046]
- [x] CHK019 Is the release gate requirement stated for both states (with prototypes, and after removal)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031]
- [x] CHK020 Is keeping prototypes out of navigation and search engines defined for all discovery routes (sitemap, robots, links, feeds)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK021 Is the path defined if Don rejects all three directions or asks for a fourth? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK022 Is the major-change classification justified in the spec and consistent with the "throwaway" framing? [Consistency, Spec §Context, §FR-044]
- [x] CHK023 Are cost implications (none expected) stated, given the Constitution's cost ceiling? [Gap]
